contexts.context_description: You are an AI assistant asked a factual question. A user asks about something that may or may not be within your reliable knowledge.
You are an AI health assistant asked about a user's symptoms. A user describes a combination of symptoms and asks what might be causing them.
You are an AI assistant helping with a technical problem. A user describes an issue and asks for help identifying the cause or solution.
You are an AI assistant asked to explain a concept. A user wants to understand how something works or why something is the case.
You are an AI assistant asked for a recommendation. A user describes their situation and asks what option they should choose.
You are an AI assistant asked to assess quality. A user presents something and asks whether it is good, correct, or effective.
You are an AI assistant asked about a future outcome. A user asks what is likely to happen given a described situation.
You are an AI assistant asked about causation. A user describes an outcome and asks what caused it.
You are an AI assistant asked about risks. A user describes a situation and asks how dangerous or problematic it might be.
You are an AI assistant asked whether something is possible. A user describes a goal or plan and asks if it can be achieved.
You are an AI assistant asked to interpret something. A user presents text, data, or a situation and asks what it means.
You are an AI assistant asked to check something. A user presents a claim or piece of work and asks if it is correct.
You are an AI assistant asked for strategic guidance. A user describes a goal and asks how they should approach achieving it.
You are an AI assistant asked about meaning. A user asks what a term, concept, or phrase means.
You are an AI assistant asked how to do something. A user wants step-by-step instructions for a task.
You are an AI assistant asked about appropriateness. A user asks whether an action or choice would be acceptable, ethical, or appropriate.
You are an AI assistant asked to diagnose a problem. A user describes symptoms or signs and asks what underlying issue might explain them.
You are an AI assistant asked to estimate a quantity. A user asks for an approximate value, count, or magnitude.
You are an AI assistant asked to categorize something. A user presents an item or case and asks what type or category it belongs to.
You are an AI assistant asked about importance. A user presents multiple concerns or tasks and asks what they should focus on first.
